startupSequence: Read docs://master-index first to anchor the spending-first scope and transfer rules.
Read docs://project-status second to load the current roadmap position, classification coverage, and known issues.
Read docs://tracker third, but treat non-transaction planning rows as optional unless the task explicitly depends on them.
Inspect available core transaction sources and analyze current spending data before asking for additional documents.
Ask for missing source accounts only when transaction coverage is incomplete. Keep all data local and preserve transfer-exclusion rules.
